transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Tuesday, September 1. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. It's time to move from endless war to end of war: PM Modi to Putin. Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged President Vladimir Putin to end the ongoing conflict. He emphasized that humanity's well-being depends on moving from endless war to peace. India supports all efforts to resolve issues peacefully and swiftly. Discussions also covered expanding cooperation in various key sectors. 'I don't have anything more to give': Lionel Messi retires from int'l football. Lionel Messi has officially announced his retirement from international football, wrapping up a remarkable chapter in his illustrious career. He described this decision as both difficult and necessary, highlighting the timing as crucial. In his statement, Messi expressed deep appreciation for his fans, noted the significance of nurturing emerging young players, and leaves the sport with fulfillment and dignity. Haldwani 'purification' row: Day after FIR against Rahul, BJP, Cong trade barbs. The Congress party slammed the FIR against Rahul Gandhi, calling it casteist. BJP countered that Rahul raised the issue belatedly after a threat from Kharge. An FIR was registered against Rahul Gandhi under various sections and the SC/ST Act. The complainant alleged Rahul gave a caste angle to cleaning work at the rally. Oracle layoffs: Company leadership may again send the '6 am' email on September 1. Oracle employees expect layoff emails on September 1, the day its fiscal second quarter begins, with managers asked to submit lists of affected employees and some teams facing double-digit cuts. Staff fear a repeat of March 31, when a 6 am email from "Oracle Leadership" told 10,000 workers their role was eliminated. Oracle has already cut 21,000 jobs this fiscal year while spending $55.7 billion on AI data centres. IMD predicts below-normal rainfall over India in September. September rainfall across India is predicted to be below normal, concluding the monsoon season deficiently. August was the warmest on record, with several regions experiencing record high temperatures. Cumulative rainfall from June to August shows a significant deficit, impacting agricultural sowing and increasing irrigation costs. Strong El Niño conditions are expected to persist, negatively affecting monsoon rainfall patterns. Tupac Shakur death case: Duane 'Keffe D' Davis convicted of first-degree murder. Duane Davis was convicted of orchestrating Tupac Shakur's 1996 murder. The jury reached its verdict after nearly thirty years since the shooting occurred. Prosecutors presented multiple statements where Davis admitted responsibility for the fatal incident. His defense argued he was lying, but no witness corroborated this claim. Times Square stabbing: 1 killed, 1 critically injured; suspect shot dead by NYPD. At least one person was killed and another critically injured after a woman allegedly stabbed two people in New York City's Times Square before she was fatally shot by police, authorities said. OpenClaw that Sam Altman spent billions on gets 'largest update in its history'. OpenClaw has unveiled its most comprehensive software upgrade yet with the arrival of version 2.0. This update enhances user accessibility significantly and integrates features for multi-user collaboration. Installation has been streamlined, along with expanded cross-platform automation tools. The redesigned browser interface provides a centralized workspace that improves navigation, while sophisticated routines and enhanced information retrieval tools elevate the overall user experience. Power failure hits Jaipur centres again, AIIMS CRE exam cancelled. NEW DELHI: A day after a power failure disrupted NEET-PG 2026 at two examination centres in Jaipur, the AIIMS Common Recruitment Examination (CRE) 2026 was hit by a similar power supply failure at the same centres, forcing AIIMS to cancel the test there and schedule a fresh examination for September 7. Nepal tragedy: Owners missing, dog refuses to leave flood-hit Trishuli home. A black-and-white dog remains at the site of four homes destroyed by a flood. He refuses to leave the muddy patch where his home once stood. Rescue workers and JCBs clear debris around the steadfast canine. Volunteers offer food and water, which he accepts quietly when alone. 245-year-old live oak from Revolutionary War battle freed from chains. Dedicated arborists are engaged in the meticulous restoration of a 300-year-old live oak tree located near the historic Eutaw Springs battlefield in South Carolina. The project involves the careful removal of outdated metal supports to enhance the tree's longevity, while modern support systems and improved soil conditions are being implemented, all in preparation for the upcoming 250th anniversary of the United States.

transcript.title: Bhopal and Madhya Pradesh
transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. Vijay Shah Case: Prosecution Sanction Pending Before Governor, MP Government Tells Supreme Court. The Madhya Pradesh government told the Supreme Court that a decision on sanction to prosecute minister Vijay Shah over his controversial remarks against Colonel Sofiya Qureshi is expected shortly and is pending before the Governor. MP River Pollution Crisis: 18 Of 48 Major Rivers Fail BOD Standards, NGT Flags Sewage Treatment Gap. The NGT has flagged Madhya Pradesh's sewage crisis after CPCB data showed monitoring locations across 18 of 48 rivers failing BOD standards. Congress Triggering Rifts In Society, BJP Must Come Up With New Plan: CM Mohan Yadav. Chief Minister Mohan Yadav accused Congress of creating social divisions and urged BJP workers to counter its strategy at the party's executive meeting in Orchha. Six Surveys, Still No Final Boundary: Bhopal's Bhoj Wetland Set For Fresh Demarcation. Bhopal's Bhoj Wetland, including Upper Lake, may undergo its seventh boundary demarcation in nearly 30 years after the NGT took up encroachment concerns. Bhopal Health Directorate's Vehicles, Laptops Attached Over rupees 4 Crore Outstanding Dues. Vehicles, computers and laptops at Bhopal's Directorate of Health Services were attached following a district court order over dues exceeding rupees 4 crore, including interest. TET Exemption Row Again Reaches SC, Tribal Teachers Seek Relief For 2005-09 Appointees. The Tribal Welfare Teachers Association has moved the Supreme Court seeking TET exemption for Madhya Pradesh teachers appointed between 2005 and 2009, arguing they fulfilled eligibility requirements then. Madhya Pradesh CM Mohan Yadav inaugurates Nishatpura Railway Station in Bhopal Akashvani News. MP Tops India In Forest Diversion, Accounts For Over 22 percent Of National Total In 10 Years. Madhya Pradesh recorded India's highest forest-land diversion between 2014-15 and 2023-24, with 38,552.61 hectares approved for non-forestry use, according to MoEFCC data submitted to Parliament. Protesters storm CJP's 'School Thik Karo' meeting in Bhopal, raise slogans against campaign. Situation result of govt's policy failure: Bhopal traders seek halt of drive. Vehicles without insurance could be denied fuel at Madhya Pradesh petrol pumps. Bhopal Leopards Cricket Team matches, scorecards, news and statistics. '90 percent of Bhopal's e-waste burned and disposed unscientifically'. Child's preference for parent not enough to determine custody dispute: Madhya Pradesh High Court. Unnat Krishi Mahotsav 2026 concludes in Raisen, Madhya Pradesh. BMC to continue 'shutdown' drive against commercial activity in residential areas. Madhya Pradesh CM Dr Mohan Yadav reviews flood situation, meets affected people in Chitrakoot. Over 100 businesses 'shutdown' voluntarily.

The subscription reached 244.41 times, showcasing strong investor interest. Mid, smallcaps notch 5th straight monthly gain; benchmarks in red. On Monday, Nifty 50 index recovered 86 points from the intraday low and settled at 24,080.40, lower by 95.25 points or 0.39 percent . NSE's CAS turnover surged to rupees 39,718 crore, nearly 22 per cent of cash-market turnover, as MSCI rebalancing triggered sharp price swings in dozens of stocks Skyways Air Services IPO listing today. MarketSmith India reveals its top stock recommendations for today, 1 September. Get expert insights into the best-performing stocks to guide your investment decisions. Eco Hotels and Resorts launches 58-room hotel in Shirdi, Maharashtra. With the addition of this property, Eco Hotels has crossed 280 operational rooms and is set to further expand its portfolio with a 52-room property in Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar in October and a 16-room boutique hotel in Ayodhya within the next 45 days, taking its portfolio to approximately 350 rooms ahead of Diwali. The discussions follow a Sebi study on individual traders' losses in the F and O segment in 2025-26, which showed that while total losses moderated year-on-year, the average loss per trader rose. July records $4.1 billion in PE/VC investments; exit value falls 83 percent. transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. ITR filing August 31, 2026, deadline today: Due date for AY 2026-27; Check who must file return. ITR filing deadline: Taxpayers with business or profession income must file their returns today. This deadline applies to those using ITR-3 and ITR-4 forms. More than seven crore income tax returns have already been filed. Individuals and HUFs with presumptive business income use ITR-4. Do small caps really deliver higher earnings growth than large caps? Here's what investors need to know. Small- and mid-cap stocks have delivered much faster earnings growth than large caps over the long term. But a closer look at margins, recent performance and the impact of a few extreme performers reveals why investors should look beyond headline profit growth. Dubai-based homebuyer cancels 2 Mumbai flats after long delay, but builder kept him waiting for refund and wanted to deduct charges: MahaREAT orders full refund + rupees 1.33 crore in interest. Dubai based homebuyers books two flats in Mumbai from Dubai office in Sheikh Zayed Road of Sion, Mumbai based builder; but builder delays possession; homebuyers cancels booking; MahaREAT orders rupees 1.33 crore interest compensation plus full refund. Read the article to know how the homebuyer won the case. From borrowing $4,000 to becoming a billionaire: Two investing lessons from Ray Dalio. Billionaire Ray Dalio's financial setback in the early 1980s changed his approach to investing. After a major miscalculation left him broke, he learned two key lessons: question your own certainty and embrace diversification to manage risk. September 2026 bank holidays: Banks to remain closed for Janmashtami, Ganesh Chaturthi, Karma Puja and more; check state-wise holiday list. Bank holidays in September 2026: In September 2026, customers in different Indian states should anticipate bank closures for a variety of festivals. It's wise to consult the RBI holiday calendar for effective planning. Timely completion of essential banking tasks is critical, so proactive checks are recommended. Also, scheduled and non-scheduled banks will observe holidays on the second and fourth Saturdays, helping to prevent any last-minute banking challenges for customers. High Beta leads in 1-year returns: A look at how 5 factor investing styles performed against Nifty 500. Factor investing strategies delivered sharply different returns over the past year. High Beta emerged as the strongest performer, while Value also outpaced the broader market. Here's how all five strategies compared with the Nifty 500. 8th Pay Commission salary calculator: Up to rupees 14.10 lakh arrears for Level 4-7 employees? Here's how it could add up. 8th Pay Commission news: Central government employees receive arrears on basic pay after pay commission implementation delays. Dearness allowance and house rent allowance are not typically paid as arrears. Transport allowance also does not accrue arrears due to its fixed nature. Estimates show significant arrears for Level 4-7 employees at various fitment factors. Aadhaar DOB update: Can you change your date of birth more than once? UIDAI rules explained. UIDAI has clarified that Aadhaar holders can request DoB updates more than once, but subsequent changes face stricter rules. The process depends on the existing DoB status, documents submitted earlier and the circumstances behind the correction. Filing ITR-3 for AY 2026-2027? Here's 7 aspects to look out for before filing it. The deadline to submit ITR-3 forms for non tax audit business income is set for August 31, 2026. For those requiring a tax audit, the submission date extends to October 31, 2026. Important updates for AY 2026-27 include new reporting obligations for specific non-residents under Section 44BBD, and taxpayers must disclose political party details to claim deductions under Section 80GGC. EPFO: Uncovered workers get one-time window to enrol under special social security drive , check dates, other details. EPFO has urged employers to enrol uncovered workers under its one-time Employees' Enrolment Campaign, 2026, to expand social security coverage. The scheme was notified in June and will continue till 31 October. rupees 16 lakh cash seized in income tax raid, tax officer calls it unexplained cash; Taxpayer claims it to be family money, he fights and wins the case in ITAT Mumbai. During an income tax search operation (raid) rupees 16 lakh cash was seized; Man says its family cash; tax officer does not believe him and calls it unexplained cash; he wins case in ITAT Mumbai. Read the article to know how. Last few hours to file tax return: Key pre-filled details ITR-3 and ITR-4 filers must cross-check. With the ITR filing deadline just hours away, taxpayers using ITR-3 and ITR-4 should carefully review pre-filled details. From income and tax credits to capital gains and deductions, here's what you need to verify before submitting your income tax return. No smartphone, no internet? PhonePe launches new UPI service for feature phone users. The fintech company has joined hands with handset makers such as Nokia, HMD, Lava International and itel to have the service pre-installed on their devices. 8th Pay Commission Arrears: Check how much Level 4-7 employees may receive; fitment factor-wise calculation. The government hasn't confirmed the estimated arrears under the 8th Central Pay Commission. Employees should consider the figures illustrative, subject to change. NPS charges revised from October 1, 2026: Check new PoP onboarding and annual charges for NPS, NPS Lite. Starting on October 1, 2026, new charges will be introduced for the National Pension System. All subscribers are required to pay a one-time onboarding fee of rupees 200 to register for PRAN. Additionally, active schemes will incur an annual fee of 0.20 percent of Assets Under Management (AUM). However, those opting for digital onboarding will benefit from a reduced charge of rupees 100. Start a gram-based SIP in gold and silver FoFs: Axis MF launches industry-first Shagun SIP for investors. Axis Mutual Fund has launched Shagun SIP, an industry-first gram-based SIP for gold and silver fund of funds (FoFs). The feature lets investors choose a gold or silver quantity instead of a fixed rupee amount. Here's how it works, its key benefits, and what investors need to know. 8th Pay Commission pension calculator: rupees 6.72 lakh more? See how 11-year commutation could change pension benefits. ​Central government pensioners can commute up to 40 percent of basic pension as a lump sum at retirement. The commuted portion is then deducted from monthly pension and restored after 15 years. Several employee and pensioner organisations want this period reduced to 10–12 years.​ Writing a will online and its hidden risks: Why the cheap and fast option isn't for everyone. Digital estate-planning services are making it easier to create a will, but simple DIY options may not suit everyone. NRI in Brazil, client in Goa: where will your professional income be taxed?. An NRI in Brazil providing architectural services to a Goa company may still face Indian tax. But the India-Brazil tax treaty could cap the tax at 10 percent of the gross professional fees. NPS schemes get a new classification: What PFRDA's revised framework means for your investment choices. PFRDA has revamped the classification and display of NPS schemes, with MSF schemes grouped by equity exposure. The framework aims to make scheme comparison easier for subscribers, with clearer information on risk, returns and other key parameters. DA update: Himachal CM announces welfare measures, additional rupees 20,000 in salary arrears for retirees. Key things to know. Himachal CM says state committed to welfare of employees and pensioners, assures that DA payment will come in due course.
